# Setup: Linux (Debian-based — primary platform)

This is the reference platform (Linux Mint, Ubuntu, Debian, Pop!_OS). Other
distros work; the package names differ.

## 1. Install dependencies

```bash
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git libsdl2-dev
```

Optional, for a richer editing experience:

```bash
sudo apt-get install -y clangd ninja-build    # language server + fast builds
```

## 2. Clone and build

```bash
git clone https://github.com/FreeOpenSourceSyndicate/FreeOpenSourceSyndicate.git
cd FOSSynd
./scripts/build.sh
```

## 3. Run

```bash
./build/src/FOSSynd
```

Controls (prototype): left-click a tile to move the selected agent, **Tab** to
select the next agent, arrow keys to scroll, **Esc** to quit.

## 4. Test

```bash
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

## Core-only build (no SDL2 needed)

Useful when you only touch `src/core/`:

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DFOSSYND_BUILD_GAME=OFF
cmake --build build -j
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

## Troubleshooting

### `SDL2 not found`

Install `libsdl2-dev`. Verify with `pkg-config --modversion sdl2`. If SDL2 is in
a non-standard prefix, set `SDL2_DIR` or `CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH`.

### No display (SSH, CI, headless server)

Use the headless flags, which select the dummy video driver:

```bash
./build/src/FOSSynd --headless --frames 30
```

### Wayland vs X11

SDL2 chooses automatically. To force a driver, set `SDL_VIDEODRIVER`, e.g.
`SDL_VIDEODRIVER=x11 ./build/src/FOSSynd`.
